items.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Inaugurates CG Semi Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test Facility in Gujarat
items.whyInNews: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the CG Semi Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) facility in Sanand, Gujarat on July 5, 2026. The facility is expected to boost India's semiconductor manufacturing capabilities.
items.summary: The CG Semi OSAT facility in Sanand, Gujarat was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 5, 2026. This facility is a significant step towards making India a major player in the global semiconductor industry. The facility will provide employment opportunities and contribute to the country's economic growth, with an investment of approximately Rs 1,000 crore.
keyPoints: CG Semi OSAT facility inaugurated in Sanand, Gujarat
Facility expected to generate employment opportunities for over 1,000 people
Investment of approximately Rs 1,000 crore in the facility
Facility to contribute to India's economic growth and semiconductor manufacturing capabilities

Historical context: First semiconductor assembly and test facility in India, expected to reduce dependence on imports

Policy implication: Expected to contribute to India's economic growth, generate employment opportunities, and reduce dependence on imports

items.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Launches Vikasit Udan Scheme
items.whyInNews: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Vikasit Udan scheme on July 5, 2026, which aims to enhance regional air connectivity in India.
items.summary: The Vikasit Udan scheme was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on July 5, 2026. The scheme aims to enhance regional air connectivity in India by providing financial support to airlines and developing infrastructure at smaller airports. The scheme is expected to boost economic growth, generate employment opportunities, and improve connectivity in remote areas.

items.title: ISRO Successfully Conducts Integrated Parachute Tests for Gaganyaan
items.whyInNews: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conducted integrated parachute tests for the Gaganyaan mission on July 5, 2026.
items.summary: The ISRO successfully conducted integrated parachute tests for the Gaganyaan mission on July 5, 2026. The tests were conducted to validate the parachute system for the crew module of the Gaganyaan spacecraft. The Gaganyaan mission aims to send Indian astronauts to space by 2026.

Key statistic: Gaganyaan mission to be launched on a GSLV rocket, with a crew of three astronauts
Policy implication: Expected to demonstrate India's capabilities in space technology and human spaceflight

items.whyInNews: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar's visit to the Gulf nations comes against the backdrop of fast-evolving political dynamics in the region following the peace agreement between the U.S. and Iran. The tour starts on July 5, 2026.

items.title: India weathered West Asia crisis through strategic decision-making, diplomacy: PM Modi
items.whyInNews: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India successfully navigated the West Asia fuel crisis through strategic decision-making and diplomacy. The crisis was mitigated without fuel rationing or price surges.
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted India's strategic decision-making and diplomacy in overcoming the West Asia fuel crisis. Domestic refineries increased LPG production, and public sector OMCs absorbed losses. Modi promised further expansion of refinery capacity to ensure energy security.

items.title: Finance Ministry notifies rules for determination of origin of goods under India-U.K. trade pact
items.whyInNews: The Finance Ministry has notified rules for determining the origin of goods under the India-U.K. trade pact, which secures duty-free access for 99% of India's exports to the U.K.
items.summary: The Finance Ministry has notified rules for determining the origin of goods under the India-U.K. trade pact. The pact provides duty-free access for 99% of India's exports to the U.K., covering nearly the entire trade basket. The rules aim to prevent misuse and ensure compliance with the agreement.
